title: Elastic Bridge: Eloquent-Style Queries for Elasticsearch and OpenSearch
content:
Elastic Bridge brings fluent Elasticsearch and OpenSearch queries to Laravel, with model-style documents, aggregations, pagination, and testing fakes.

The post Elastic Bridge: Eloquent-Style Queries for Elasticsearch and OpenSearch appeared first on Laravel News.
